# 133. Läkemedelsfest, kinesiska kopior och Jensens comeback

**Feed**: borssurr  
**Published**: 2026-11-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts (Henrik Mitelman and Gabriel Mellqvist) cover a choppy week in which tech and semiconductors swung hard around Jensen Huang's return at Nvidia. They call Sanofi's $41bn bid for Insmed the week's key news and expect more M&A in pharma ahead of large patent expiries. Chinese competition runs through the episode (an Engcon tiltrotator copy, BYD/Denza, McKinsey's finding on stressed European industrials), alongside disappointing capital markets days at Sandvik and Tomra, the SKF Vertevo spin-off, a hot US economy pushing the Fed towards rate hikes, rising private-credit defaults and a structural seller hitting Scandi Standard.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ SCST — Scandi Standard | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Major Portuguese holder has turned seller; the stock has slumped on a structural seller.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion: the stock long benefited from a structural buyer that now seems to have switched to selling. Owning a stock with a large holder steadily selling is unattractive, so be wary near term. A possible Lantmännen bid is speculated but dismissed as conspiratorial.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Portuguese major holder stops selling
- if a takeover bid emerges

> *"Så jag skulle nog akta mig lite för Scandi Standard."*

---

### 🟠 ENGCON-B — Engcon | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Week's loser at -10%; Chinese tiltrotator copy seen at Bauma Shanghai.

#### Reasoning

Hosts see the Chinese copy as symptomatic of China competing on price. The company is mid-transformation. They do not know whether the copy is any good, so this is a cautious watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Chinese competitors take market share
- if margins erode

> *"Tiltrotatorn som är Östersunds stolthet, Encon. Och nu får de tydligen konkurrens."*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Stock has flattened, valuation is low and the pill is promising, but Lilly and Chinese copies are threats.

#### Reasoning

Host hopes for a turnaround after the price flattened, citing analyst Lars Söderfjell's view that it may have turned. Bulls point to a rarely low valuation; bears say Eli Lilly has won and Chinese copies are taking share. Host is unsure he would put money in.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oral pill results disappoint
- if Chinese copies keep gaining share

> *"Jag vet inte om jag skulle våga riktigt stoppa pengarna där själv, men man hoppas ändå att den här klenoden ska få luften i vingarna igen."*

---

### 🟡 SAND — Sandvik | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Fell 5% after keeping its margin targets; hosts praise the restraint and its market-share gains.

#### Reasoning

Hosts disagree with the market's negative reaction. Keeping realistic targets and beating them beats over-promising. A mining-equipment analyst says Sandvik is gaining share versus Epiroc and doing a lot right.

#### Sell Triggers

- if market share gains reverse
- if it fails to meet its existing targets

> *"Det verkar som att Sandvik gör väldigt mycket rätt just nu."*

---

### 🟠 TOM — Tomra | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Down 26% in 3 months; cut targets at its CMD. Hosts like the humility but see delayed recycling policy and new competition.

#### Reasoning

A studio favourite that has hurt investors who bought it as cheap. Lowered targets show credibility, but recycling regulation has been pushed back and competition, perhaps Chinese, is stronger than expected. Still looking for a bottom.

#### Sell Triggers

- if recycling regulation is delayed further
- if competitors take market share

> *"Någonstans borde det ha bottnat ur, men man sänkte ju faktiskt sina mål"*

---

### 🟠 SAN — Sanofi | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

The market rewarded the Insmed deal; hosts expect a pharma M&A wave in which buyers also rise.

#### Reasoning

Patent expiries will force big pharma to buy growth. Sanofi gained SEK 100bn in value on its bid, so other CEOs will likely follow. Hosts suggest owning large acquirers too, not just targets.

#### Sell Triggers

- if acquirers start being punished for deals
- if the integration fails

> *"Då kan du äga stora bolag också, för de går också upp när de köper."*

---

### 🟠 FOI-B — Fenix Outdoor | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Down ~75% from the peak, but Q3 sales up €10m and the stock rose on the report; a possible turnaround.

#### Reasoning

Hosts see signs of a turnaround in sales growth after a long decline and compare it to Novo's flattening. The Fjällräven brand works across very different markets.

#### Sell Triggers

- if sales growth stalls

> *"Så kanske är det ett nytt Novo Nordisk slamkryparen som ska vända"*

---

### 🟠 EKTA-B — Elekta | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Really good report this week after difficult times, including China issues.

#### Reasoning

Hosts are pleased with the strong report after a tough period marked by Chinese headwinds. Positive, but no explicit call.

#### Sell Triggers

- if China issues return
- if the next report disappoints

> *"Elekta kommer ju faktiskt med en riktigt bra rapport i veckan, vilket vi gläder oss väldigt mycket åt."*

---

### 🟠 NOTE — Note | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

CEO and CFO leaving at the same time; stock down over 5% and down YTD.

#### Reasoning

Both executives leaving together is a bad sign. Weak cash flow and organic growth likely lie behind the change. Hosts call it a disappointment, though they like the company.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cash flow and organic growth do not improve

> *"Alltså när båda går samtidigt, det där är inte bra."*

---
